params.body:
The store has not been Sanity for months, but its four doors still carried the name: `/sanity/query`, `/sanity/patch`, `/sanity/create`, `/sanity/delete`. They are now `/store/*`.

- The server rewrites an incoming `/sanity/*` path to `/store/*` in one line at the top of the handler, so an open dashboard or studio tab keeps working through this deploy. That line and the second name in `isReadRequest` go in the follow-up, once dashboard and studio call `/store/*`.
- The probe token's one allowed POST is `/store/query` (and the old name for now); the tests pin both, and that `/store/query/../patch` is not a read.
- `bin/probe.mjs` calls `/store/query`.

Step 2 of 3 in removing the Sanity layer. Tests: 953 pass.
params.title: Name the store's doors /store/*
